brief:
Hamas said it remained prepared to proceed with a US-backed Gaza peace plan and called for international pressure on Israel, which denies agreeing to the latest phase of negotiations, Middle East Eye reported. A Hamas official told AFP the group had not rejected any part of the agreement.

Israel insists it did not consent to the most recent terms under discussion. The disagreement reflects the distance between the parties on key provisions as mediators work to bridge differences over the proposed deal's implementation and scope.
